name: Wreck the Deck
short: Take control of a powerful pirate cannon and turn everything on deck into flying debris! Shoot cannonballs, destroy objects, trigger devastating shockwaves, and collect cash to unlock powerful upgrades. The more you wreck, the stronger your cannon becomes.
about: Wreck The Deck  is an incremental Physics/Destruction Pirate game!            Take control of a  Powerful Cannon  to sink enemy ships!             Think  before you shoot           Upgrade  your cannon          Shoot a variety of objects &  Collect  the loot
min_req: Minimum:     OS:  Windows 10+    Processor:  Intel i3 or Ryzen 5    Memory:  2 GB RAM    Graphics:  NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or similar    Storage:  1 GB available space
